name: WdFramesetSizeType
description: Specifies how to interpret the height or width of a specified frame on a frames page.

constants.name: wdFramesetSizeTypePercent
constants.description: Word interprets the height or width of the specified frame as a percentage of the screen height or width.

constants.name: wdFramesetSizeTypeFixed
constants.description: Microsoft Word interprets the height or width of the specified frame as a fixed value (in points).

constants.name: wdFramesetSizeTypeRelative
constants.description: Word interprets the height or width of the specified frame as relative to the height or width of other frames on the frames page.
